panels.description: Sitara faces Roman beside the aligned records; her copied Merritt files lie between them. Leave upper-left clear.
Roman’s hand rests near the treatment file without covering it. Leave upper-right clear.
Sitara looks directly at Roman, controlled but accusatory. Leave upper-left clear.
The two separate TJs remain physically apart. Their displays show different local partitions and record counts. Keep silent and uncluttered.
